title: REQ · npm test runs the tracked-dependency guard and fails when a path is tracked
summary: A CLI guard script is chained before vitest in the test script
description: Context: package.json test is only vitest run. Desired: test runs the guard script then vitest, and the script exits non-zero when tracked dependency or cache paths exist. Why: enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Given a git runner returning a tracked node_modules path, when the guard main runs, then it throws and exit code is non-zero
Given package.json, when scripts.test is read, then it invokes the guard before vitest run
definition_of_done: npm test fails while a dependency path is tracked
